title.en: An Act to Amend Section Seven of Republic Act Numbered Five Hundred and Sixty-Seven, Entitled “An Act to Amend Title VI of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred and Sixty-Six, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code, as Amended,” to Make the Rates Prescribed Therein Permanent
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Seven of Republic Act Numbered Five Hundred and Sixty-Seven, Entitled “An Act to Amend Title VI of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred and Sixty-Six, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code, as Amended,” to Make the Rates Prescribed Therein Permanent

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1507_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section seven of Republic Act Numbered Five hundred and sixty-seven, as amended by Republic Act Numbered Seven hundred and twenty-five, Republic Act Numbered Eight hundred and seventy, Republic Act Numbered One thousand and ninety-two, and Republic Act Numbered One thousand two hundred and seventy-four, is further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 7. The provisions of this Act shall take effect upon its approval."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
